repairs_and_rechecks.issue: Existing launcher TAU2_DATA_DIR included an extra tau2 directory.
repairs_and_rechecks.resolution: Set checkout/data; both tau2 and Banking covered by regression and wheel startup checks.

repairs_and_rechecks.issue: Pinned native telecom manual failed under the Windows GBK default.
repairs_and_rechecks.resolution: Use the launcher existing UTF-8 subprocess setting; direct CLI now clearly requires PYTHONUTF8=1. Native and wheel checks passed with UTF-8.

repairs_and_rechecks.issue: Existing text bridge omitted MultiToolMessage tool results.
repairs_and_rechecks.resolution: Render nested native tool messages. The telecom integration test asserts the actual customer lookup result reaches the target.

repairs_and_rechecks.issue: Initial native test selected a telecom variant outside the default base pool; 36 passed, 2 failed.
repairs_and_rechecks.resolution: Select a real base task with two required user actions; recheck 38 passed, then add two retail episode cases, final 40 passed.

repairs_and_rechecks.issue: Initial unit configuration fixture lacked required role model names.
repairs_and_rechecks.resolution: Supply explicit fixture target/worker names; all 31 unit/launcher cases passed before native checks.

limitations: No real model or Algorithm x Target x Benchmark smoke: role API credentials are not configured.
One rollout per task, mean native reward; no pass^k aggregation.
Only standard airline, retail and telecom text domains; no voice, multilingual, solo or telecom workflow modes.
Native global paths/Judge defaults are scoped with a per-simulation lock; execution is serialized within a process.
Hard task_timeout remains POSIX-only and was not revalidated on this Windows host.
Local task directories are not a security sandbox for file-capable agents.
